_comment: German catalogue for the messages THIS FRONTEND renders — see order-flow-localization-backend-module.ts. Codes the SERVER renders live in the server package's own catalogue, and the two key sets are disjoint by design. DELIBERATELY PARTIAL — an untranslated code falls back to its English default. Nested keys are flattened on '/', so these are the hydranium/<package>/<name> codes the framework publishes.
